resources.string: Tests Android microphone permission only. Press the floating button outside this app to sample the microphone locally. No audio is stored or sent. Do not test during a TeamSpeak connection.
Allow overlays and microphone access, unlock the device, and end any TeamSpeak connection before arming.
Presses: %1$d. Capture starts: %2$d. Presses with usable input: %3$d. Failures: %4$d. Start p50/p95: %5$s. Release p50/p95: %6$s.
Use an isolated test channel and get everyone’s consent. Expand the overlay to select a temporary mic mode. Selecting Always on or Gate starts the microphone. In Hold mode, hold the button to speak.
Connect to a channel and stop any existing recording. Allow overlays, microphone access and notifications; unlock the device and finish any call before arming.
Connected PTT is ready. No recording. Go Home to show the overlay.
